pack.topic: Sensor Tap Calibration and Plumbing Quality Audit
pack.source_script_insight: Touchless sensor taps and modern plumbing fixtures can suffer from feedback loops or improper control valve calibration, causing continuous water running and massive resource wastage if auto shutoff fails.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In modern Coimbatore home builds around Peelamedu and Race Course, installing smart sensor faucets without verifying sensor placement and solenoid valve calibration leads to wasted overhead tank water and unnecessary pressure pump cycling.
pack.core_takeaway: Always inspect and test sensor tap auto-shutoff timing and solenoid valves before taking possession of modern plumbing setups.

scenes.purpose: Hook showing continuous water running defect in a modern ceramic sink basin.
scenes.visual: Close-up 9:16 vertical shot of a modern chrome deck-mounted faucet pouring water nonstop into a white ceramic basin on a grey stone vanity top in a finished Coimbatore home restroom.
scenes.camera: Eye-level steady micro-pan tracking water stream flow into drain.

scenes.purpose: Demonstrate hand removal while water continues to flow continuously without auto-shutoff.
scenes.visual: Hand waves under the faucet sensor and withdraws completely, but water continues flowing at full pressure without stopping.
scenes.camera: Slight medium close-up, fixed angle angled slightly downward showing empty counter space.

scenes.purpose: Expose the cause - incorrect sensor positioning catching light reflection or water spray.
scenes.visual: POV shot showing mirror-mounted sensor ring reflecting chrome reflection, causing false motion trigger feedback loop.
scenes.camera: High angle tilt down from mirror sensor to tap spout.

scenes.purpose: Show inspector checking under-counter solenoid valve and electronic control unit.
scenes.visual: Under-sink inspection inside wooden vanity cabinet showing engineer testing solenoid valve connections and control unit wiring.
scenes.camera: Low angle close-up with soft flashlight illumination under counter.

scenes.purpose: Show calibration adjustment to set auto shut-off timer to exactly 3 seconds.
scenes.visual: Hand re-calibrating tap sensor sensitivity setting on control box with tiny red highlight box overlay around dial.
scenes.camera: Tight close-up shot focused on control module dial adjustment.

scenes.visual: Inspector waves hand under tap; water flows instantly and stops automatically after 3 seconds upon hand removal.
scenes.camera: Medium shot of full vanity basin, subtle green checkmark icon overlay on shutoff.

scenes.purpose: Provide final takeaway on pre-handover plumbing verification with OliveTree Builders branding overlay.
scenes.visual: Quality engineer marking plumbing inspection checklist on clip pad inside completed interior setting with subtle logo overlay.
scenes.camera: Eye level shoulder-up shot panning slightly to reveal clean vanity space.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic 10-second vertical 9:16 video for OliveTree Builders, targeting homeowners in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The video must consist of EXACTLY 7 distinct photorealistic live-action scenes, each lasting 1.0 to 1.5 seconds. The entire video must look 100% like authentic smartphone/gimbal footage captured on an active Indian home inspection site. NO 3D renders, NO cartoon/toon graphics, NO CGI animation, NO white background infographics, NO floating 3D models.

SCENE BREAKDOWN (10 SECONDS TOTAL):
- SCENE 1 (0.0s - 1.5s): Close-up 9:16 vertical shot in a modern Coimbatore residence restroom. A sleek chrome high-arc faucet is pouring water at high pressure into a clean white ceramic basin resting on a matte grey granite countertop. The water is running uninterrupted into the drain. Minimal transparent overlay text in bold white font: 'தொடர் நீர் வீணாகிறதா?'. Audio: Concise voice-over 'சென்சார் குழாய் நிற்குமா?' with realistic ambient running water acoustics.
- SCENE 2 (1.5s - 3.0s): Angle shifts to a medium close-up shot. An engineer's hand briefly triggers the motion sensor tap and then completely steps away from the sink area. The water continues to pour without stopping, illustrating an auto shutoff defect. Text overlay: 'ஆட்டோ கட்-ஆஃப் ஃபெயிலியர்'. Voice-over: 'கட்-ஆஃப் சரியாக இயங்காததால்,'.
- SCENE 3 (3.0s - 4.5s): First-person POV camera tilt from the mirror-mounted blue sensor LED down to the water stream, demonstrating light reflection off chrome causing a continuous sensor feedback loop. Text overlay: 'சென்சார் தவறு'. Voice-over: 'தவறான சென்சார் அமைப்பால்,'.
- SCENE 4 (4.5s - 6.0s): Low angle close-up under the vanity counter inside the open wooden slatted cabinet. A technician uses a pen light to examine the solenoid valve and electronic control box connected to flexible braided inlet hoses. Text overlay: 'வால்வ் பரிசோதனை'. Voice-over: 'நீர் தொடர்ந்து வீணாகிறது!'.
- SCENE 5 (6.0s - 7.5s): Ultra close-up of hands calibrating the sensor sensitivity dial on the control unit module. A fine red line box highlights the calibration dial. Text overlay: 'டைமர் அளவீடு'. Voice-over: 'சரியான டைமர் அளவீடு,'.
- SCENE 6 (7.5s - 8.8s): Return to medium vanity shot. A hand waves under the tap; water flows instantly and automatically cuts off 3 seconds after hand removal. A subtle green checkmark graphic appears over the spout. Text overlay: '3 செகண்ட் கட்-ஆஃப்'. Voice-over: 'நீரைச் சேமிக்கும்!'.
- SCENE 7 (8.8s - 10.0s): Quality inspector holding a digital inspection clipboard, placing a checkmark next to 'Plumbing & Sensor Auto-Shutoff Audit'. Modern Coimbatore residential bathroom background with warm architectural lighting. A small non-intrusive 'OliveTree Builders' brand stamp appears in the lower corner. Text overlay: 'ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ தரப் பரிசோதனை'. Voice-over: 'ஆலிவ்ட்ரீ பில்டர்ஸ்.'.

CONTINUITY & VISUAL STYLE:
Maintain strict physical continuity across all scenes—same grey vanity countertop, same ceramic sink, and same chrome faucet fixture throughout. Lighting must be natural indoor bathroom LED lighting typical of premium Coimbatore newly constructed homes. Text overlays must be short (1-3 words), clean sans-serif Tamil script with subtle drop shadow for maximum legibility on mobile screens.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Do NOT include cartoon, anime, 3D CGI render, plastic skin, fake water, unrealistic fluid simulation, glossy corporate explainer graphics, full-screen end logo screen, text overlays exceeding 4 words, unrealistic camera jumps, floating text bubbles, non-Tamil audio, or out-of-context construction elements.
pack.title_english: Sensor Tap Water Leak? How to Audit Auto-Shutoff Taps Before Handover
pack.caption_english:
Installing smart sensor taps in your new Coimbatore home? Without proper sensor positioning and solenoid valve calibration, auto-shutoff taps can run continuously, wasting tank water and running up electricity bills from pressure pump cycling.

At OliveTree Builders, our pre-handover MEP snagging checklists ensure every touchless fixture, valve calibration, and auto-shutoff timer is rigorously tested for flawless performance.

Building your dream home in Coimbatore? Partner with OliveTree Builders for uncompromising quality execution.
